issue.title: Graph node dragging stops moving nodes after static worker layout change in #216

comments.body:
Fixed in 3a061a9560faa0d84ffa1df16b5eeae7f804eb2c (`Fixes #218`).

Regression: `round4-drag` in `scripts/brand-browser-round4.ts`, driven by the headless Playwright fixture harness. Real mouse and single-touch gestures move the rendered node during the gesture, retain the final position after release, and cancel pending worker settling. Panning, click selection and keyboard navigation remain available. Reverting only the x/y/velocity assignments reproduces the failure with actual browser input. The cancellable module worker remains in place; the 2,000-node settle check still yields input and cancels superseded work.

[Revert proof](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/pr-screenshots/brand/pm-web-triplicate/round4/revert-proofs.json) and [screenshots](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/tree/pr-screenshots/brand/pm-web-triplicate/round4).

Reverified in `54e7983f505dacf327f1c75a41d5c6ca96e4e8b5`. The existing direct-drag fix passes `BRAND_REGRESSION_ONLY=round4-drag node scripts/brand-browser.ts` across 1440/768/390 in light/dark: real mouse and single-touch motion, release position, pending-settle cancellation, panning, click selection and keyboard navigation. The GraphCanvas implementation remains unchanged in this round; the consumed canvas bundle is byte-identical across the kit updates. [Six-group browser receipt](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/pr-screenshots/brand/pm-web-triplicate/round6/issue-218-drag-report.json). The PR body retains `Fixes #218`; the issue remains open for orchestrator verification.
